# Barbara Będowska-Sójka

> Barbara Będowska-Sójka is a full professor and head of the Department of Econometrics at Poznań University of Economics and Business, Poland. She works on financial markets, financial econometrics, fintech and network science applied to financial data.

- Affiliation: Department of Econometrics, Poznań University of Economics and Business, Poznań, Poland
- Research interests: financial markets, financial econometrics, cryptocurrency markets, volatility, liquidity, high-frequency data, fintech, network science, time series modelling, data analysis, portfolio management
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=noyoyCYAAAAJ

## Research projects

- [NCN OPUS 13 (UMO-2017/25/B/HS4/01546)](https://barbbs.github.io/project-opus13.html): 10 publications, funder: Narodowe Centrum Nauki
- [NCN OPUS 21 (UMO-2021/41/B/HS4/02443)](https://barbbs.github.io/project-opus21.html): 6 publications, funder: Narodowe Centrum Nauki
- [NCN OPUS 22 (LAP z GAČR) (UMO-2022/45/B/HS4/00864)](https://barbbs.github.io/project-opus22.html): 1 publications, funder: Narodowe Centrum Nauki
- [COST Action CA19130 FinAI (CA19130)](https://barbbs.github.io/project-cost.html): 5 publications, funder: European Cooperation in Science and Technology
- [MSCA Doctoral Network DIGITAL (101119635)](https://barbbs.github.io/project-digital.html): 2 publications, funder: Komisja Europejska, Horizon Europe MSCA
- [NCN MINIATURA 3 (2019/03/X/HS4/01025)](https://barbbs.github.io/project-miniatura.html): 1 publications, funder: Narodowe Centrum Nauki
- [Regionalna Inicjatywa Doskonałości (MNiSW) (004/RID/2018/19)](https://barbbs.github.io/project-rid.html): 2 publications, funder: Ministerstwo Nauki i Szkolnictwa Wyższego
